messages:
mike_sales: Acme POC: after metadata upload they cant SSO, login 500s and SCIM returns 403. Need quick triage.

nina_se: Can you drop the metadata file or URL here and any error snippets?

mike_sales: They sent metadata URL: https://acme.example/.well-known/saml/metadata.xml. Log shows: 
```
ERROR saml: validateAssertion: signature verification failed
POST /scim/v2/Users 403 token_scope_error
```

kai_infra: signature fail usually cert mismatch. Also 403 = SCIM token missing write scope. Did portal import the metadata or was it manual entry?

mike_sales: Portal import via metadata URL. Customer said they rotated certs earlier tonight.

olga_sso: If they rotated certs and we cached metadata, we might have stale certs. Our metadata TTL is 10m. I'll force-refresh the tenant metadata and log the assertion issuer.

devops-bot: Job scheduled: metadata/force-refresh -> staging. No downtime.

olga_sso: After refresh, signature verifies. SCIM still 403. The token they provided has scopes: ["scim:read"]. Need scim:write or provisioning scope. Also their SCIM endpoint returned incomplete cert chain; our client rejects it.

nina_se: We can unblock POC by issuing temporary API keys to a few users while they fix SCIM and cert chain. Sales ok with that?

mike_sales: Yes, ok for up to 5 seats for 48h. I'll send waiver for TLS exception if they request.

kai_infra: Customer regenerated token with proper scopes and uploaded full chain. I re-triggered SCIM sync: 
```
POST /scim/v2/Users 201 created 4 users
POST /scim/v2/Groups 200 updated 6 groups
```

mike_sales: Customer confirms SSO working and users provisioned. POC unblocked.

olga_sso: Filing ENG-6482 to: warn on entityID mismatch at import, validate cert chain early, and show required SCIM scopes in onboarding UI.

nina_se: Added short checklist for sales: check entityID, cert chain, NameID format, token scopes, and force metadata refresh.

mike_sales: Thanks team! Closing thread. :tada:
